h: Shabbos Prepares Each Soul for Its World to Come

p: The second meal is that of Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב פח, א)
as stated in the holy Zohar (II 88a).
he reckons three holinesses of Shabbos:
for Binah includes all three upper sefiros,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג ד, א)
and from the union of Chochmah and Binah,
which is the inwardness of Keser Elyon;
"Then you will understand the fear of Hashem
and find the knowledge of God."
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (הַקְדָּמָה ה, ב)
as stated in the holy Zohar (Introduction, I 5b)
when it enters the depths of the heart,
one merits the aspect of Daas.
And this is what is said:
of what is written in the Tikkunei Zohar
which is 'a tower of strength, the Name of Hashem'" (Mishlei 18:10).
And as for what is written,
it seems that the intent is
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב רַשִׁ״י (חֲגִיגָה טו, ב)
on "a tower floating in the air":
for the lamed rises above all the letters.
אַךְ לָמָּה ל׳ אִימָּא עִלָּאָה בִּינָה
But why is lamed the supernal Mother, Binah?
But according to what was said,
that Binah includes all three upper sefiros,
it may be understood according to what is written
בְּרַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רכג, ב)
to the fifty gates of Binah;
which includes the three upper sefiros,
And in the Osios of Rabbi Akiva,
"lev meivin daas," a heart that understands knowledge;
and this too is to this intent:
and this is "a heart that understands";
and Daas is the inwardness of Keser Elyon,
and it is the fiftieth gate
which is revealed to baalei teshuvah
And this is "a heart that understands knowledge."
וּבַגְּמָרָא יֵשׁ גַּם כֵּן רֶמֶז לָזֶה
And in the Gemara too there is an allusion to this,
a crown for the World to Come";
'for the World to Come' is the lamed."
This seems to make no sense,
for the lamed is a prefix,
and one could just as well say "for this world"
But the intent is as stated:
as stated in the Raya Mehemna
and lamed is the World to Come,
and that is the World to Come.
And this is what he says,
that "the World to Come" is the lamed.
And this is what is written in the Zohar Chadash (on this parshah):
"And through the secret of Shemittah and Yovel
the Holy One, blessed be He, accepted
the prayer of Sarah, Rivkah, Rachel and Leah,
for they are all marked with a hei,
for hei is Shemittah and Yovel.
that Shemittah and Yovel are alluded to
while she has no mark of hei,
וְהַמְכֻוָּון עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (בְּרָכוֹת טז, ב)
The intent is according to what is stated (Berachos 16b):
therefore the two heis of Bilhah
And the reason they are called "Mothers":
for Knesses Yisrael is the lower Mother,
is at the beginning of the name of Leah,
and at the end of the name of Rachel."
This seems to make no sense;
is made only for Yisrael, etc."
אֲשֶׁר בָּנוּ שְׁתֵּיהֶן אֶת בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל
who both built the house of Yisrael" (Rus 4:11).
and from Yehudah came Mashiach ben David,
who will be a chariot for the middah of Malchus,
And Rachel built the end of Knesses Yisrael,
and from him comes Mashiach ben Yosef,
they shall inherit the land forever" (Yeshayahu 60:21)
have a share in the World to Come.
which is Binah, the World to Come,
is set at the beginning of the name of Leah,
for she built the head of Knesses Yisrael,
will be the preparation for the World to Come.
And so too it is set at the end of the name of Rachel,
for she built the end of Knesses Yisrael,
and from her comes Mashiach ben Yosef,
who will clarify that all Yisrael
have a share in the World to Come,

p: And in the Gemara (end of Berachos, 64a):
nor in the World to Come,
he will appear before God in Tziyon.'"
and from beis midrash to beis midrash.
And in its plain sense we said,
אֵין הַמֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁע בְּרָב חָיִל וְגוֹ׳
"A king is not saved by great strength, etc.":
for the Rabbis are called kings
that the words of Torah would help them
to be saved from the yetzer hara.
And about this the verse says:
his yetzer is greater than him"
that is, one who conquers his yetzer
by the great power" he has
to be able to overcome by himself
renews itself against him every day,"
with a greater assault against him.
רַק הִנֵּה עֵין ה׳ אֶל יְרֵאָיו
Only "Behold, the eye of Hashem is on those who fear Him,
on those who hope for His kindness" (Tehillim 33:18):
for Hashem Yisbarach in His kindness
"will not abandon him into his hand,"
as stated in the Gemara there
But according to what was said,
And each one has a world
כִּי הוֹלֵךְ הָאָדָם אֶל בֵּית עוֹלָמוֹ
"For man goes to his eternal home,"
That is, Shabbos is a semblance of the World to Come,
one-sixtieth of the World to Come
according to the holiness of the Shabbasos
so will he have in the World to Come
And this is what it says:
which is the holiness of Shabbos,
he will have the holiness of the weekdays.
וְהוּא דְּאָדָם לְעָמָל יוּלָּד (אִיּוֹב ה, ז)
And this is "Man is born to toil" (Iyov 5:7):
that is, to the toil of Torah,
to be a vessel for Torah"
and for one who does not merit it,
it is to the toil of work,
that is, the doing of mitzvos,
like the work of the Mishkan,
and so too every act of this world
when it is intended for the sake of Heaven;
or to the toil of speech,
for the toil of actual work
and the toil of idle talk.
And according to the holiness of his weekdays
so will he have in the future
the days between Shabbos and Shabbos,
And one who merited in his lifetime
to be a vessel for Torah,
and for whom they resemble Shabbasos and Yamim Tovim
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב רַעְיָא מְהֵימְנָא צַו כט, ב)
(as stated in the Raya Mehemna, Tzav, III 29b)
it is for the toil of Torah,
an influx of words of Torah
So too in the World to Come,
in the days between chayil and chayil
they will have rest and delight
until "he will appear before God in Tziyon."
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתְבוּ הַמְקוּבָּלִים
This is according to what the Kabbalists wrote,
that there will be seven Shemittos,
and in them they will have
according to the holiness of the Shabbasos
according to how he kept them in this world;
they will have the holiness of the weekdays,
And afterward, in the fiftieth millennium,
"he will appear before God in Tziyon,"
when they will have the World to Come
from what is stated (end of Tamid)
since there will be no yetzer hara.)
that chayil means words of Torah,
for so too Yovel is words of Torah:
vav "is called the letter of truth"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיִּקְרָא)
(as stated in the holy Zohar, beginning of Parshas Vayikra),
beis is the beginning of the Torah,
lamed is the end of the Torah.
which correspond to the ten utterances
and the Ten Commandments of the Giving of the Torah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג יא, ב)
are the sum of the words of Torah,
and likewise the twenty-two letters of the Torah
are the sum of the words of Torah.
to bring the words of Torah down to earth,
we make the words of Torah.
And this is in Binah, Yovel,
which is the words of Torah.
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּתִיקּוּנֵי זֹהַר הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
as stated in the Tikkunei Zohar cited above;
"that hangs the roof of the ches,"
as if to say, He lives
in the heights of the world;
And this is the intellect hidden
one also merits a drawing down
from Binah, the World to Come,
עַל מִי שֶׁאֵין בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
about one who has no fear of Heaven."
"Then you will understand the fear of Hashem,"
which is the fiftieth gate of Binah,
and this is through the union
And this one merits at this meal,
which is called the meal of Atika,
which includes all three upper sefiros
